pages.raw_title: RadNet | Our Mission. Our Values. - Leading Radiology Forward
pages.raw_meta: RadNet is leading radiology forward by working with our partners to deliver medical imaging services. Learn more about mission and values.
raw_blocks: RadNet is the national leader in outpatient imaging. Backed by 45+ years of experience, we deliver high-quality, cost-effective solutions for all 442 ctr (as of 6/30/26) in our network—and for our strategic partners.
RadNet’s mission — comprehensive radiology solutions — aligns with the future of healthcare.

We are the only radiology provider with the resources to create greater opportunities for our strategic partners. We leverage our national profile and a broad portfolio of clinical and technical services to support best outcomes.

We make it easy for everyone involved in healthcare decisions — administrators, physicians, IT professionals, technologists — to work together. Above all, that includes patients. Recent findings show that patients who are actively involved in their healthcare experience better outcomes and incur lower costs.

Our focus is simple. We deliver high quality, conveniently accessible care in the most cost effective manner possible. Quality, access, and value are at the core of what we do — in every new imaging center we establish, every health system that we partner with, every patient we encounter. That is the RadNet difference.

RadNet's success is based on strong leadership, exemplary business acumen, and a drive to be the best.
The Board of Directors has driven RadNet to its leading position in a dynamic healthcare landscape.
Founded in 1981 – over 4 decades of experience.
Company has quadrupled in size since 2006.
Publically Traded (Nasdaq: RDNT); RadNet’s management owns over 25% of common stock.
442 locations (largest in the United States), about 1,000 contracted radiologists and more than 11,000 employees worldwide.
Largest provider of radiology clinical AI solutions worldwide.
Regional networks in Arizona, California, Delaware, Idaho, Indiana, Florida, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Texas and Virginia.
Emphasis placed on scale and multi-modality strategy – one stop shopping for referral sources and health plans.
Facilities offer state-of-the-art equipment in a modern and patient friendly setting.
Top 100 in InformationWeek’s 500 Most Innovative Companies.
Voted one of the “Most Wired” Imaging Companies by Imaging Technology News.
Reported as #1 Imaging Center Chain by Radiology Business Journal.

pages.raw_meta: RadNet serves patients, providers and payors through its network of 290+ radiology outpatient centers in California, New York, Maryland and other states.
raw_blocks: Right Image, Right Setting, Right Cost
Reliable results—that’s what you count on. Our patients and referring physicians get appropriate, accurate, cost-effective procedures. Payors benefit from our flexibility and geo-access base.

The top radiologists in the country, IT innovation, strategic relationships, 45+ yrs of imaging experience, research leadership— this is the expertise we leverage across all of RadNet, for every exam, in every location.
As the largest provider of outpatient imaging in the U.S., RadNet brings the most advanced equipment, flexible hours, extensive payor participation, and convenience to patients and providers.
RadNet participates with hundreds of insurance plans and offers the most competitive pricing for out-of-pocket and self-pay expenses. You get results you can trust, often at a lower price.
In an increasingly confusing healthcare landscape, RadNet aligns the resources necessary for clear decisions and patient-centered care.
From technology innovation to clinical decision tools, we deliver the services you need for better clinical outcomes and business success.
RadNet participates with every major healthcare plan in the market. That depth makes us a total imaging solution partner with proven results.
